newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota unit to export used cars to New Zealand.
newsitem.headline: Toyota unit to export used cars to New Zealand.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Friday that one of its units will start exporting used Toyotas to New Zealand.
Toyota Used Car Sales Co, a wholly owned subsidiary of Toyota Motor, will export Toyota passenger cars and commercial vehicles, a Toyota spokeswoman said.
Toyota New Zealand Ltd, Toyota's 100 percent owned manufacturing unit, will repair and sell them, she said.
Toyota expects it to sell 3,000 vehicles a year, she said.
Sales of used cars have been growing in New Zealand since the government abolished a system under which used car importers must have a licence, the spokeswoman said.
